title: Season 1
overview: Maya Lopez reconnects with her Choctaw heritage and family while confronting the syndicate she left behind.

episodes.title: Chafa
episodes.overview: After attempting to kill Wilson Fisk, Maya Lopez flees New York City and returns to her hometown of Tamaha, Oklahoma.

episodes.title: Lowak
episodes.overview: Maya enlists her estranged family to help hijack a munitions shipment belonging to Fisk's criminal empire.

episodes.title: Tuklo
episodes.overview: Fisk's enforcers track Maya to Oklahoma, endangering those closest to her.

episodes.title: Taloa
episodes.overview: Maya experiences visions of her ancestors and is forced to confront a shocking confrontation.

episodes.title: Maya
episodes.overview: During the annual Choctaw Nation powwow, Maya embraces her heritage and confronts Wilson Fisk once and for all.

verification.notes: Verified Echo Season 1 episode roster (5 episodes) released simultaneously on January 9, 2024.
